repos.name: mikehasa/agentacct
repos.description: See what your coding agents did and what it cost. Breaks each task down into work steps — tools used, files changed, tests run, time and tokens spent. Local-first dashboard for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more. No login, no telemetry.
repos.one_liner: A local-first observability and cost-tracking dashboard specifically designed for AI coding agents.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based local dashboard that parses agent logs and execution metadata.
Purpose: Provides granular visibility into the efficiency and financial cost of autonomous coding agents.
Use Cases: Auditing token consumption, tracking file modification history, and verifying the ROI of AI-driven development workflows.
Key Features: Breaks down tasks by tools used, tests run, and total time spent per agent session.
repos.img_alt: agentacct tui — live usage, cost, provider rate-limit bars, and recent sessions with per-session weekly-plan-cost estimates
repos.img2_alt: agentacct tui session detail — the per-step work ledger with pass/fail check evidence and a weekly-plan-cost estimate

repos.name: simonlin1212/vibe-astock
repos.description: A 股短线复盘看板：涨停池·连板梯队·龙虎榜·板块资金一屏看完，赚钱效应/晋级率/梯队断层/情绪周期等派生指标纯计算直出（不经过 AI），AI 只把数据串成能读的盘面研判。全本地运行，可用 Claude/Codex 订阅免 API key。| A-share short-term daily-review dashboard: derived sentiment metrics computed locally, AI only writes the narrative. No API key needed.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, local-first dashboard for A-share market sentiment analysis and short-term trading review.
bullets: Tech Stack: Python-based engine utilizing deterministic calculation for market metrics rather than relying solely on LLMs.
Purpose: Visualizes complex market data like limit-up pools, liquidity ladders, and sentiment cycles to identify trading opportunities.
Use Cases: Daily market review for quantitative traders and retail investors focusing on short-term momentum.
Key Features: Fully local execution with optional AI integration for summarizing market narrative, supporting Claude/Codex for analysis.

repos.name: Flaminis/Dalaran
repos.description: Dalaran — Apache-2.0, robotics-first visualization and data infrastructure for multimodal time-series. ROS 2 native, reads existing .rrd recordings. A hard fork of Rerun.
repos.one_liner: A robotics-first, high-performance visualization and data infrastructure tool for multimodal time-series analysis.
bullets: Tech Stack: Rust-based, hard fork of Rerun, optimized for high-throughput data streams and ROS 2 native integration.
Purpose: Provides a robust infrastructure for visualizing and analyzing complex, multi-sensor time-series data.
Use Cases: Analyzing high-frequency financial tick data, sensor fusion in robotics, or any time-aligned telemetry stream.
Key Features: Supports existing .rrd recording formats and offers low-latency rendering for large-scale datasets.
